sentences.text: The revisional application has been preferred challenging the continuance of the proceedings arising out of Daspur Police Station Case No.45 dated January 26, 2021 under Sections 498A/323/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Mr. De, learned advocate appearing for the petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon Mr. Imran Ali, learned advocate, who ordinarily appears on behalf of the State.
His appearance may be regularised by the concerned authorities.
The main thrust of contention of the petitioner is that the petitioner is a physically disabled person and he is interested to take back his wife.
The wife/defacto complainant/opposite party no.2 left the matrimonial home on her own and there were no reasons for the same.
The petitioner for the said purpose filed an appropriate civil case for restitution of conjugal rights.
I have also taken into account the allegations made in the FIR as well as in the charge-sheet and the connected documents.
I am of the view that the contentions so advanced cannot be considered at this stage.
Petitioner would be at liberty to canvass such points at the stage of consideration of charges by way of taking out an application under Section 239 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, if so advised.
